entries.value: "Improvement-request store (SQLite) for base-studio-code (#3295, epic #3260) — the designer→debug channel: a confined session (bsc ui) files discrete, grounded requests a full-capability debug session reads and resolves. Contractual (each request stands alone), not a conversation."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Tauri-free core lib + the `bsc request` subcommand, so the umbrella binary, the app, and any session
# reuse it without relinking the whole app (mirrors plandb/errordb/bsc-loop).
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches src-tauri) for cross-platform reliability.
# Shared SQLite open + busy_timeout plumbing (the `conn` feature) — so a CLI write never races the app.
# Shared CLI scaffold: cli_main + resolve_store_path (--db→env→default) + the CmdDoc help system.
